k:斑.mnemonic: The king (王) spills ink while writing a sentence (文). One dark blot lands on his white robe and will not wash out. Spot (blemish, speck, patches).
k:斑.hint: An ink blot on the robe.

k:斥.mnemonic: A single drop (丶) of rain lands on the woodcutter's axe (斤). With one flick of the blade he bats it away: not wanted here. Reject (retreat, recede, withdraw).
k:斥.hint: Flicking a raindrop off the blade.

k:罷.mnemonic: A fisherman with real ability (能) throws his net (罒) down on the dock and walks off the job for good. Quit (stop, leave, withdraw).

k:錬.mnemonic: As the sun rises in the east (東), the smith heats the gold (金) again, hammers it, cools it and repeats, making it tougher every morning. Tempering (refine, drill, train).

k:慨.mnemonic: Your heartbeat (忄) sinks when you think of what you did previously (既). If only you could take it back. A long sigh. Rue (be sad, sigh, lament).

k:詮.mnemonic: Everyone gets a say (言) until the whole (全) matter has been talked through from every side and a way forward is chosen. Discussion (methods called for, selection, result).

k:渇.mnemonic: For a decameron (旬), ten whole days, no rain has fallen. You dream of a tsunami (氵) but have only a spoon (匕) of water left. Thirst (dry up, parch).

k:凹.mnemonic: A block with a pit (凵) pressed into its top: the middle sinks below the two edges. Concave (hollow, sunken).
k:凹.hint: A block dented in the middle.

k:褐.mnemonic: A cloak (衤) worn for a whole decameron (旬), ten days of stew dribbled from the spoon (匕). It is now the colour of mud and gravy. Brown (woollen kimono).

k:漆.mnemonic: Cut a tree (木) beneath its hat (𠆢) of leaves and sap runs out like water (水). Brush on a tsunami (氵) of coats and a plain bowl gleams black. Lacquer (varnish, seven).

k:汎.mnemonic: A tsunami (氵) plays no favourites: it covers the grand and the mediocre (凡) alike, across the whole map. This is the prefix for all-embracing. Pan-.

k:嫡.mnemonic: At the ceremony one woman (女) stands on the podium (啇) facing (向) the guests. She alone is the official spouse, and her children inherit. Legitimate wife (direct descent).

k:殉.mnemonic: For a decameron (旬), ten days, he kept vigil beside his lord's bones (歹). Then he gave up his own life to follow him. Martyrdom (follow by resigning).

k:弊.mnemonic: The sparkle (⺌) of cash (幣) in twenty (廾) greedy fingers: money grabbed with both hands breeds every kind of rot. Evil (abuse, our, vice).

k:愁.mnemonic: Autumn (秋) settles on the heart (心): leaves fall, the days shorten, and a quiet sorrow moves in. Distress (grieve, lament, be anxious).

k:挫.mnemonic: A person (人) trips over another on the soil (土) and lands badly. Fingers (扌) clutch the twisted ankle as it swells. Sprain (crush, break, discourage).

k:旺.mnemonic: The king (王) at the height of the day (日): sun blazing on his crown, his realm at the peak of its strength. Flourishing (successful, beautiful, vigorous).
k:旺.hint: A crown under the noon sun.

k:藻.mnemonic: A tsunami (氵) drags flowers (艹), a tree (木) and crates of goods (品) out to sea. Soon green ribbons grow all over them underwater. Seaweed (duckweed).

k:紡.mnemonic: Loose fluff floats off in every direction (方) until the wheel turns and draws it into one long thread (糸). Spinning.
k:紡.hint: Fluff drawn out by a wheel.

k:泌.mnemonic: Hold back a tsunami (氵) with a wall and the water will invariably (必) find the cracks, seeping through bead by bead. Ooze (flow, soak in, penetrate).

k:蜜.mnemonic: Under the roof (宀) of the hive, each insect (虫) invariably (必) comes home with nectar and stores it away as sweet gold. Honey (nectar, molasses).
k:蜜.hint: Sweet gold stored in the hive.

k:桟.mnemonic: Builders with no planks lash halberd (戈) shafts across tree (木) poles, making a frame they can climb and stand on. Scaffold (cleat, frame, jetty).

k:舷.mnemonic: You lean over the edge of the boat (舟) to stare into the mysterious (玄) dark water, gripping the top rail of its side. Gunwale.

k:蛍.mnemonic: An insect (虫) whose sparkle (⺌) floats past your forehead (冖) on a summer night, blinking on and off. Lightning-bug (firefly).
k:蛍.hint: A blinking light on summer nights.

k:氾.mnemonic: A tsunami (氵) bursts the riverbank, lifting a fishhook (乙) from the pier and a stamp (卩) from the office desk and carrying them over miles of flat fields. Spread out (wide, broad, spacious).

k:爽.mnemonic: A person (人) lifts the lid (亠) off a cold drink on a hot day and takes one (一) long gulp. Ahh. Refreshing (bracing, resonant, sweet).

k:薪.mnemonic: New (新) logs, split today and stacked with dried flowers (艹) and grass for kindling, ready beside the stove. Fuel (firewood, kindling).

k:儒.mnemonic: A leader (亻) whose teaching is in demand (需): rulers send for the sage to learn about duty, ritual and respect for elders. Confucian.

k:拷.mnemonic: The fingers (扌) of a village elder (耂) pinch a boy's ear and keep pinching until he confesses who took the plums. Torture (beat).

k:刹.mnemonic: A monk takes a knife (刂) to a tree (木), carving beams and pillars, and raises a hall of worship in the forest. Temple.
